requirements.summary: Workflow agent autonome qui accepte un article à rechercher, ouvre the observed catalogue, récupère les 10 premiers articles observés, visite chaque page produit disponible, extrait nom, description et prix, puis écrit un fichier Excel sous workflows/observed-product-extraction.

outcomes.description: Un fichier Excel est sauvegardé sur le disque avec les colonnes Nom, Description et Prix.
Les 10 premiers articles demandés sont traités dans l’ordre observé, sans déduplication ni filtrage supplémentaire.

tasks.objective: Bind typed copies of the requested article, build the the observed catalogue search URL for that exact article text, define the purpose-specific XLSX path under workflows/observed-product-extraction, and bind the supplied headers in order.
Open the the catalogue search results page for the requested article and observe complete bounded rendered pages before extraction.
Bind typed search observation status and assert producer-declared success, availability and completeness before candidate extraction.

For each complete observed search-results page, extract offered product/article candidates as compact Candidate[] per page without extra filtering or deduplication; preserve original observed action data, hrefs, visible text blocks and IDs verbatim.

Flatten the per-page Candidate[][] in observed order, keep original candidates unchanged, create a compact ID decision view, and bind exactly the first 10 offered article candidates available in order without deduplication.
Visit each of the requested first 10 original product links in order. If a product URL is null, branch on null and preserve a null detail row instead of inventing data.
Branch on whether the original candidate has a navigable URL.
Open the product page for this original candidate and observe complete bounded rendered pages before detail extraction.

From the complete observed product page, extract the name, description and price verbatim. Description is the whole relevant offered feature/text block; heading is optional; null means absent or uncertain subject. Preserve the original candidate action data.
Bind a typed null-detail copy for a requested candidate whose URL is absent, preserving the original candidate text and ID verbatim.

Assemble typed XLSX rows with the supplied headers prepended, one row per requested visit in original order. Copy name, description and price verbatim; keep null cells for absent or uncertain fields. Bind final rows and status before writing.
Write the exact typed rows to an Excel file under workflows/observed-product-extraction, preserving headers and cell values, and save before any cleanup.
Assert writer-declared success and return the writer path together with typed final status.
